description: No clean concept found; firing is diffuse. Weak tendency: fires when I must block an immediate opponent threat, strongest (top 0.1%) when the opponent just played column 3 and now threatens to win on the top cell of column 3 via a row or diagonal. Plain vertical threats in column 3, and bottom-row threats, do not fire. Many firings have no threat at all, often with column 3 full.
effect: Raises the probability of column 3 by about 0.05-0.2 when forced high (lowers it by 0.06-0.11 when zeroed); no effect when column 3 is full or already certain.
notes: 6 score calls. Best dev F1 0.121 (any must-block, AUROC 0.60); col-3-forced-move search 0.098; col-3 must-block 0.110 (precision 0.16); forced-move 0.090; high non-vertical must-block 0.043. Simulation share negative for all programs (best -0.12). Minimal pairs: constructed col-3 must-blocks do not fire; row-0 must-blocks push it negative; col-3 height alone does nothing. Single-cell histograms flat. Looks like a mixture or random direction with a column-3 output component. Synthesis best 6.85 (dev max 6.99), not beaten.
